summary: A Yes vote imposes a special parcel tax on property in the City of Orange Cove.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve a parcel tax to fund police, parks, and recreation services.
tax.quote: Unlike Measure O, which solely funded public safety, the parcel tax would fund both police department services and parks and recreation services.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the parcel tax and leave the city without this additional revenue for those services.
